description: Rename a subsystem, move it under another parent (parent: name/id, or "" for top level; its components and child subsystems come with it), change its signal flow, or mark it as an enclosure (every wire or cable crossing its frame must then pass a feed-through or gland on its wall).

enclosure.description: true = an enclosure (cabinet, box): crossings need a feed-through or gland; false = a plain subsystem

name: update_subsystem
title: Update subsystem
